name: MBRIGHT
recent: Meta Bright 公布 2026 财年第四季业绩，营收按季增长 17.2% 至 7417 万令吉，净利按季大增 204% 至 506 万令吉，但净利按年仍下滑 15.5%。公司同时宣布子公司委任新加坡与菲律宾的独家分销商，将能源方案拓展至新加坡、菲律宾及砂拉越，并进军医疗保健领域。此外，公司将于 12 月 1 日召开第 26 届常年股东大会。
notable: 子公司委任新加坡与菲律宾的 Bumi-Earth 产品独家分销商，将能源方案拓展至新加坡、菲律宾及砂拉越，并进军医疗保健领域。
执行董事 Dato' Lee Wai Mun 于 11 月 2 日至 4 日期间在闭市期内在公开市场增持公司股份。
公司发布 2026 年报及企业治理报告，并发出第 26 届常年股东大会通知。
risks: 执行董事 Dato' Lee Wai Mun 在闭市期内多次交易公司股份，需留意合规披露。
2026 财年第四季净利按年下滑 15.5%，尽管按季大幅回升。
earnings: 2026 财年第四季（截至 6 月 30 日）营收 7417 万令吉，按季增 17.2%，按年增 14.1%；净利 506 万令吉，按季增 204%，但按年减 15.5%；净利率 6.8%，高于上季的 2.6%。

recent_en: Meta Bright reported 4QFY2026 results with revenue up 17.2% QoQ to RM74.17 million and net profit up 204% QoQ to RM5.06 million, though net profit fell 15.5% YoY. The company also announced its subsidiary appointed exclusive distributors in Singapore and the Philippines, expanding energy solutions into Singapore, the Philippines and Sarawak, and entering the healthcare sector. Its 26th AGM is scheduled for 1 December.
notable_en: Subsidiary appointed exclusive distributors of Bumi-Earth products in Singapore and the Philippines, expanding energy solutions into Singapore, the Philippines and Sarawak, and entering the healthcare sector.
Executive Director Dato' Lee Wai Mun acquired shares in the open market during the closed period between 2 and 4 November.
The company released its 2026 Annual Report and CG Report, and issued notice of its 26th AGM.
risks_en: Executive Director Dato' Lee Wai Mun traded shares during the closed period, warranting attention to compliance disclosure.
4QFY2026 net profit fell 15.5% YoY despite a strong QoQ rebound.
earnings_en: 4QFY2026 (ended 30 June) revenue was RM74.17 million, up 17.2% QoQ and 14.1% YoY; net profit was RM5.06 million, up 204% QoQ but down 15.5% YoY; net margin was 6.8% versus 2.6% in the prior quarter.
